newsitem.title: UK: London envoy says Iraq has right to retaliate.
newsitem.headline: London envoy says Iraq has right to retaliate.

text.p: Iraq's envoy in London condemned Tuesday's U.S. missile attack on his country as unjustified and said Iraq had the right to retaliate.

"My government has condemned strongly this act of aggression," Ibrahim Zuhair, charge d'affaires in London, told Sky Television. "It's unjustified and we feel Iraq has the right to retaliate because we consider it unjustified, committed to terrorise the Iraqis."
"I have not received yet any instructions from my government but definitely my government will maintain its right to retaliate," Zuhair said.
U.S. forces fired a total of 27 sea-launched and air-launched cruise missiles at targets in southern Iraq.
The Pentagon in Washington said the attack, ordered by President Bill Clinton, was in retaliation for Iraqi military attacks against Kurds in the north.

Zuhair said he believed the attack was part of Clinton's re-election strategy and said Iraq had the right to move troops within its terrority, even if this occurred within the Western-declared safe haven.
